entries.name: nested-degrade-leak-not98-accept#0
entries.description: Output 0's tree is size-flagged and segregated (header 0x18) and parses: constants [Box, SigmaProp(true)], body placeholder 1. The Box constant's own tree is 0b0ad1efefefefefefefeffd, which degrades at depth 10 as in degraded_tree_depth_leak. Nested inside a tree that parses, the degrade still leaves its 10 levels on the reader: every enclosing frame lowers the level by one from wherever it is. Output 1's tree body is BoolToSigmaProp(LogicalNot^98(placeholder)): 10 + 98 + 2 = 110. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: nested-degrade-leak-not99-reject#1
entries.description: The same tx with output 1's tree body LogicalNot^99: 111 > MaxTreeDepth, rejected at parse. An impl that restores the level once the outer tree parses (for instance a forked reader for the sized body that hands back only its own level) round-trips the tx: the over-accept.
